strategy.thesis: Seed-stage fund backing 'vertical AI' startups embedding specialized AI into core business processes across finance, healthcare and manufacturing.

summary.en: FutureFirst Ventures is a Tel Aviv seed fund launched in February 2026 by Hila Rom (ex-RUNI Ventures founder, Tipalti) and Tammy Mahn (ex-Verizon Ventures, Moonscape Ventures), targeting a $50M raise to back vertical-AI startups with ~$1.5M initial checks. Brooks Keret is anchor/strategic partner.

summary.en: RUNI Ventures is the pre-seed/seed VC fund of Reichman University (Herzliya), established January 2023 and announcing a $30M first closing in January 2023 — only five months after the fund's establishment. Invests ~$0.5M per company plus workspace, student interns and academic mentorship.

summary.en: 2i (Dual Impact) Ventures is an Israeli VC fund launched in March 2024 to back startups building dual-use civilian/defense technologies. Backed by investment house Altshuler Shaham and the Gadot Group, with partners including ex-Vintage partner Ehud Hai and Conduit co-founder Dror Erez; it signed a strategic agreement with Israel's DDR&D.

strategy.thesis: Defense-tech fund focused on 'shields, not swords' — cybersecurity, AI, quantum and space technologies with dual-use (defense and civilian) applications; blends VC agility with private-equity depth at growth stage.

summary.en: Aurelius Capital emerged from stealth in October 2025 with a $50M initial close (targeting $150M), led by Hanaco Ventures partners Alon Lifshitz and Tomer Jacob alongside former US NSA director Michael Rogers, ex-IAF commander Amir Eshel and ex-Mossad deputy Udi Lavi. Invests in growth-stage defense-tech ('shields, not swords') across AI, cyber, quantum and space, with offices in Tel Aviv, New York and London.

strategy.thesis: Impact fund within the J-Ventures group investing only in companies generating positive social/environmental impact alongside financial returns — themes include climate/fusion energy, women's and mental health, and food. Describes its community-funded model as a 'capitalist kibbutz.'

summary.en: J-Impact is the impact arm of the J-Ventures group, which raised $22M in 2023 for sustainable/impact investments. Managed by Eran Sandhaus and J-Ventures co-founder Oded Hermoni, it backs companies in climate (e.g. NT-Tao fusion), women's and mental health, and food. Combined J-Ventures group funds had ~$43M available for investment.

summary.en: Swish Ventures is a $60M seed fund launched in December 2024 by former NBA player and investor Omri Casspi, focusing on cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure and AI with $5–7M checks into ~10 companies. It is Casspi's second fund after the $36M Sheva Capital (2022); the two firms manage ~$125M, with Sequoia Capital as anchor investor.

summary.en: M-Fund Club (Winners Club) is the angel-syndicate / SPV arm of Israeli micro-VC M-Fund, letting accredited angels co-invest deal-by-deal in early-stage Israeli startups via SPVs (run since 2019). Managed by Lior Elkan (Managing Partner) and Shiran Binyamin (CFO); the platform reports a 71% net IRR and 413% TVPI across its SPVs.
